हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A quiet househusband hides a dangerous past as an elite naval commando—until betrayal at home forces him to reclaim his identity. As his marriage crumbles and truths unravel, the man everyone underestimated rises with unstoppable force. But when the legend he once buried resurfaces, the world must face the hero they failed to recognize.
